theorems.name: Submission.dorwbl_diff_quotient_tendstoUniformlyOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (v : Euclid n), DifferentiableAt ℝ f v → ∀ R : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (r : ℝ) (w : Euclid n) => r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v)) (fun w => fderiv ℝ f v w) (𝓝[>] 0) (closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R)
